description: Purchase of 15,000 MT of urea fertilizer required for the Yala Season 2026 by the Agrarian Services Committees of the Department of Agrarian Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although it has been estimated that 550,000 hectares of paddy land would be cultivated in the Yala Season 2026, it is currently estimated that the extent would be around 450,000-500,000 hectares. It has been calculated that about 75,000 MT of urea fertilizer will be required for this. Currently, 48,297.87 MT of fertilizer are being distributed by the Agrarian Service Committees having purchased from the existing fertilizer reserves in the country. In order to ensure the supply of fertilizer at a fixed price for the Yala Season 2026, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-04-06 to provide a 50 kg bag of urea fertilizer to farmers at Rs. 10,200/- through the Agrarian Services Centres. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to purchase 15,000 MT of urea fertilizer, which is further required for the Yala Season 2026, through the Agricultural Services Committees and supply the same to farmers, was approved by the Cabinet.
